correctness.rationale: For single exterior inverse-power j the angular modes of H_{bar u_j}e_n are mutually orthogonal and direct moment computation gives λ_{n,j}=Gamma(n-j+1,R²)/n!−Gamma(n+1,R²)²/[n!(n+j)!]. Poisson-tail truncation is superpolynomially small as n grows with fixed R,j. Subtracting factorial ratios (n-j)!/n!−n!/(n+j)! yields j² n^{−j−1}(1+O(1/n)), and monotone rearrangement preserves singular-value asymptotics j n^{−(j+1)/2}. For H_{u_j} the residual norm has superpolynomial decay and orthogonal output modes; all S_p memberships follow. Higher powers j>k form faster Schatten tail and Ky Fan singular-value inequalities with ε-splitting transfer leading coefficient to a_k term without assuming the operators commute. Harmonic series proves weak endpoint, strict nonmembership and residue. Independent high-precision incomplete-gamma and symbolic factorial checks corroborate finite n; formula is analytic for all fixed parameters.
